title: Characterization of eigenfunctions of Laplacian having exponential growth using Fourier multipliers
summary: In 1993, Robert Strichartz established a characterization for bounded eigenfunctions of the Laplacian on $\mathbb{R}^d$. Let $\left\{f_k \right\}_{k\in \mathbb{Z}}$ be a doubly infinite sequence of functions on $\mathbb{R}^d$ satisfying $Δf_k= f_{k+1}$ for all $k \in \mathbb{Z}$. If $\left\{f_k \right\}$'s are uniformly bounded, then Strichartz proved that $Δf_0= f_0$, thus generalizing a classical result of Roe on the real line.
